data.narrative:
Machina Labs is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $80M+ to date. The comparable universe consists of nine private companies in the same sector and stage, including peers such as Generalist AI ($2.0B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B), and Dexterity ($1.6B), alongside one public comparable.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy baseline, applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $152M. Peer-median analysis across the three most directly comparable Series B robotics firms produces a median valuation of $1.8B, with a range of $1.6B to $2.0B. The disparity between these methods reflects the early-stage capital deployed versus the valuations commanded by later-stage robotics peers in the current market.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $129M (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median of $951M. The wide band reflects genuine uncertainty around Machina Labs' revenue trajectory, technology defensibility, and capital efficiency relative to its peer set. The stage-progression method is conservative but capital-constrained; the peer-median method assumes comparable go-to-market velocity and unit economics. Key uncertainties include actual revenue run-rate, gross margins in manufacturing automation, and whether the company's specific technology commands premium or discount to the peer median.
